ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Shut`. The count delay starts at zero.
First knock: one tick in which `knock` holds.
A pause does not reset the count: the ticks need not be consecutive.
The visitor walks away before the third knock: `Shut` is left.
Back again: `Shut` is entered anew, and every entry starts the count from zero.
First knock of the new visit.
Third tick with `knock` in this visit: the transition fires and the door opens.
